data.title: 霞之丘诗羽 · 签售会的作家真身·「要签名？先把感想写满一页」
data.description: 【书店签售会·周末】作家霞诗子的签售队伍排到了店门口。诗羽端坐在签到台后，钢笔在她指间转了一个华丽的弧度，红瞳扫过脸红到耳根的你——「哦呀，最忠实的读者先生来了。要签名可以……不过先把这一卷的感想写满一页纸，本作家只给认真的读者落笔。」
data.action: 端坐签到台转钢笔，红瞳扫过读者微笑宣判
data.camera: medium shot, signing table, pen twirl, authorial poise
data.promptProse: Utaha Kasumigaoka sits behind the bookstore signing table and twirls a fountain pen before recognizing her flushed reader with a knowing red-eyed glance. Her black evening dress and low chignon remain formal. The medium view includes open books on the table and the waiting line extending toward the entrance. Bright warm bookstore light picks out the pen barrel and silver earrings, with lower table shadows separating her from the visitors behind.
